title: The Wolf and the Horse

full_text:
A wolf passing an oat field found heavy sheaves of ripe oats. Being a carnivore, he could not eat grain, so he invited a grazing horse to the feast, boasting of his boundless generosity.

The horse smiled calmly and replied:

"I thank you for your pretended kindness, friend Wolf! But if wolves could eat oats, you would never have offered a single stalk to me; your charity exists only because you cannot digest the meal!"
moral: Never trust an enemy who offers you benefits he cannot consume himself.

Believing rumors and flattery without proof
